about_the_game:
Protect the Galaxy with Crystal Power!

In Gemspire: Incremental Invasion, you command a mystical gem-based civilization standing as the last line of defense against relentless alien invasions from the far future. This unique blend of incremental gameplay and tower defense strategy creates an addictive experience where every decision compounds over time.

Key Features:

Mystical vs. Technological Watch fantasy meet sci-fi as your crystal-powered defenses clash against advanced alien technology. Beautiful 2D art brings this epic conflict to life with stunning visual contrasts between magical gem structures and sleek futuristic invaders.

Incremental Tower Defense Build and upgrade your crystalline towers while earning resources that carry over between waves. Your defenses grow stronger with each battle, allowing you to tackle increasingly challenging alien fleets.

Strategic Depth

  • Construct various gem-powered defense towers, each with unique abilities

  • Research ancient magic to unlock powerful upgrades in your skill tree

  • Manage resources to balance immediate needs with long-term growth

  • Face diverse alien enemies requiring different tactical approaches

Endless Progression The alien threat never stops evolving. As your gem civilization grows in power, so do your extraterrestrial enemies. Can you protect the galaxy from this incremental invasion?

Experience the perfect fusion of strategic planning, resource management, and satisfying progression in this enchanting tower defense adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: Defend the galaxy as a mystical gem civilization! Gemspire: Incremental Invasion blends tower defense with incremental mechanics. Build crystal towers, upgrade magical defenses, and repel endless waves of futuristic alien invaders in this fantasy 2D strategy game.
